crossRefs.note: but these are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have…
Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ…
